assets.name: wmm-siku
assets.prompt: An Andean siku panpipe in two separate rows of bamboo cane pipes of stepped lengths, one row of exactly seven pipes and one of exactly six, each row tied with colored woven thread. The two rows are physically separate, side by side, with all thirteen open pipe ends visible. Entire objects fully in frame, on flat pure green (#00FF00).

assets.name: wmm-cuba
assets.prompt: A pair of round hardwood claves, two joined traditional Cuban bongo drums with tacked skin heads, and a Cuban tres guitar. The tres has exactly SIX metal strings arranged as THREE CLOSE PAIRS: two adjacent treble strings, two adjacent middle strings, two adjacent bass strings. Three separate paired courses run from six individual bridge anchors across the soundhole, along the fretboard, to exactly six tuning pegs, three per side. The close double lines within each pair must be clearly visible at the bridge and soundhole. Three-quarter front view, the tres nearly upright. Entire instruments fully in frame and clearly separated. Museum catalog portrait, matching warm studio light and rich realistic wood grain. Flat pure green (#00FF00) background. No people, letters or labels.
